_comment: THE SCHOOL DAY. Both Node-RED tabs read this file, so everything is defined once.
After editing, click 'Load calendar' on the Roll Call tab. No restart needed.
classStart           When the class begins, 24-hour HH:MM.
graceSeconds         A tap within this many seconds of classStart counts as ON TIME.
After it, the tap is logged as LATE and the parent is told.
600 = 10 minutes.  SET THIS TO 10 FOR A LIVE DEMO.
classEnd             From this time on, a tap means going home, not arriving.
checkoutGraceSeconds How long after classEnd to wait before asking who has still
not tapped out. 1800 = 30 minutes. Use 10 for a demo.
Kelantan / Terengganu: [0,1,2,3,4] for Sunday to Thursday.
holidays             No roll call at all on these dates.
excused              Per-date list of studentIds whose parents must NOT be chased
(sick note, approved leave, school trip). The date below is in
the past and is only an example of the format.
minPresentRatio      If fewer than this fraction of the roster arrived, the office
summary warns that the reader may be faulty.
